title: Barbecue Plant-Based Burgers
subtitle: with Slaw and Golden Fries
description: We're giving burger night a tasty vego twist with plant-based mince and moreish barbecue spices. Serve with oven-baked fries and a crisp slaw for a dinner winner.

steps.text: Roast fries: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline. Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Cut the unpeeled potato into 1.5cm-thick fries and put on the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and roast for 20-25 mins until tender.

Make patties: Meanwhile, put the plant-based mince, Aussie barbecue seasoning and 2 tsp tomato sauce in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Using damp hands, combine well, then shape into 2 equal patties, slightly larger than the base of a roll.

Cook patties: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for 3 mins each side or until browned and cooked through. Remove the pan from the heat. Meanwhile, cut the rolls in half. Put on an oven tray, cut side up, and bake for 5-6 mins until lightly toasted.

Make slaw: Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp white wine vinegar in a large bowl. Add the cabbage and carrot, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Combine 2 tbs mayonnaise, 2 tsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp white wine vinegar and 1 tsp dijon mustard in a separate bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Spread the roll bases and tops with the mayonnaise mixture. Layer the bases with the slaw and patties, then sandwich with the tops. Serve with the fries and any remaining slaw. Enjoy!
Make it yours: Fancy cheeseburgers? Before removing the cooked patties from the pan in Step 3, top with sliced cheese, then cover and cook for a further 1 min or until the cheese is slightly melted.
